create_vonmises_distribution: create a VonMises distribution with loc and concentration parameters for circular data modeling
sample_vonmises: sample random angles from a VonMises distribution using rejection sampling with a PRNG key
compute_vonmises_prob: compute the probability density of angle values under a VonMises distribution
compute_vonmises_cdf: compute the cumulative distribution function of a VonMises distribution at given angle values
compute_vonmises_kl_divergence: compute the KL divergence between two VonMises distributions using the registered TFP KL function
